title: What is Immersive Learning?
home_registration_text: Join us for Immersive LAB (De Vinci Immersive Technologies & Visual Engineering), our flagship annual research workshop bringing together researchers, students, and industry experts to explore the frontiers of immersive technologies.
home_association_tagline: Empowering students to explore, create, and innovate with immersive technologies
home_association_summary: DIVE25 forms part of a broader strategy to promote collaborative research at the intersection of management, engineering, and digital innovation. Designed as a platform for transversal dialogue, the workshop fostered knowledge sharing between institutions, disciplines, and research communities.
home_research_intro: Our interdisciplinary research group bridges engineering, design, and social sciences to advance the frontiers of computer vision and immersive technologies.
home_assoc_pillar_1_text: Strengthening interdisciplinarity between ESILV and EMLV means creating a collaborative space for researchers involving management and engineering sciences.
home_assoc_pillar_2_text: By bridging technical and managerial expertise, DIVE25 aims to shape a new research ecosystem that can respond to the complex challenges posed by immersive technologies.
home_assoc_pillar_3_text: Scientific excellence is reflected in a growing number of publications in top-tier academic journals, expanding the reach of research through practice-oriented initiatives.
home_research_pillar_1_text: Human-Computer Interaction design and ergonomics in XR | Virtual, Augmented, and Mixed Reality experiences | AI-powered metaverse applications | Privacy, security, and ethical considerations | Immersive solutions for healthcare, education, and training
home_research_pillar_2_text: Real-time object detection and tracking | Gesture and motion recognition | Deep learning for visual understanding | Thermal imaging and behavior analysis | Privacy-preserving security systems
home_research_pillar_3_text: Lifecycle management and interoperability standards | High-fidelity modeling and real-time simulation | IoT data integration and telemetry systems | Interactive analytics dashboards | Smart city and Industry 4.0 applications
